text: 9月24日，厦门迎来“8·28”地产新政后的首场土拍，2宗涉宅用地均以底价成交，总成交金额41.95亿元。其中，湖里区地块是新政后厦门首宗、也是福建省内首宗明确实行现房销售的涉宅用地，成交综合楼面价58148元/㎡，已创厦门涉宅用地楼面价新高，最终建发以底价35.61亿元竞得该地块。（券商中国）
text_en: On September 24, Xiamen welcomed its first land auction after the "8·28" real estate policy, with both residential plots sold at the reserve price, for a total transaction amount of 4.195 billion yuan. Among them, the Huli District plot is the first residential plot in Xiamen and the first in Fujian Province to explicitly implement sales of completed homes after the new policy, with a composite floor price of 58,148 yuan per square meter, setting a new high for residential plot floor prices in Xiamen. In the end, C&D acquired the plot at the reserve price of 3.561 billion yuan. (Securities Times)
